Introduces a retrieval‑only context_search tool with no automatic recall or write, affecting external data access.
Enforces a strict write contract for review submissions and adds a tripwire to detect bypass attempts.
Enables hot‑reloading of workspace trust changes in the running daemon, changing policy enforcement without restart.
Adds retryInitialDelayMs and retryMaxDelayMs settings for stream‑side and SSE rate‑limit retries, impacting provider compatibility.
